classification.difficultyReason: Shade a single complement in four supplied set configurations.

content.prompt: On each diagram, shade the region $A'$.

spec.description: Universal-set rectangle with one circle A; A is labelled above-left of the circle.
spec.mathematics: A is wholly contained in the universal set.
spec.answerVisibility: No shading in the student diagram.

answer.worked: $A'$ contains every element of the universal set that is not in $A$. Shade the rectangle outside the circle; leave the whole circle unshaded.

spec.description: Light orange shades the universal set outside A; a white mask keeps A unshaded.
Overlapping circles A on the left and B on the right inside the universal set.
spec.mathematics: A and B intersect, with neither containing the other.
spec.answerVisibility: No shading in the student diagram.

answer.short: Shade the $B$-only region and the region outside both circles.
answer.worked: $A'$ is everything outside $A$. Shade the part of $B$ outside $A$ and the region outside both circles. Leave all of $A$, including $A\cap B$, unshaded.

spec.description: Light orange outside A; all of A, including the overlap, remains white.
Separate circles A on the left and B on the right inside the universal set.
spec.answerVisibility: No shading in the student diagram.

answer.short: Shade everything outside $A$, including all of $B$.
answer.worked: $A'$ is everything outside $A$. Since $A$ and $B$ are disjoint, all of $B$ belongs to $A'$. Shade $B$ and the region outside both circles; leave $A$ unshaded.

spec.description: Light orange outside A, including the whole of disjoint B.
Large horizontal oval B contains smaller oval A positioned towards its lower-right.
spec.mathematics: A is wholly contained in B.
spec.answerVisibility: No shading in the student diagram.

answer.short: Shade everything outside the smaller oval $A$.
answer.worked: $A'$ is everything outside $A$. Shade the part of $B$ outside $A$ and the region outside $B$. Leave only the smaller oval $A$ unshaded.

spec.description: Light orange outside the smaller oval A, both inside and outside B.
